steps.text: Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall.
Buy 2 kegs of beer from Thora in Rellekka.  She will be unavailable to trade later in the quest.
Talk to Freygerd in north Rellekka.
Search the sand pit near Freygerd, ready to fight a basilisk youngling.
Search the sand pit near Freygerd for a letter.
Defeat the Basilisk Youngling.
Pick up the letter.
Read the letter.
Search the rockslide west of the sand pit.
Search the boxes south of Freygerd.
Return to Freygerd with the items you found.
Return to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall.
Talk to Brundt south east of Rellekka, asking him all available questions.
Talk to Brundt south east of Rellekka, asking him all available questions.
choices: Where can I find a Fremennik Shield?

steps.text: Talk to Brundt south east of Rellekka, asking him all available questions.
choices: Where can I get Lunar Glass?

steps.text: Talk to Brundt south east of Rellekka, asking him all available questions.
choices: How do I make the Polishing Rock?

steps.text: Talk to Brundt south east of Rellekka, asking him all available questions.
choices: How do I make V's Sigil?

steps.text: Talk to Baba Yaga in the chicken-legged house in the north of Lunar Isle's town.
Talk to Baba Yaga.
choices: I was wondering if you could help me make Lunar Glass?

steps.text: Enter the mine in the north east of Lunar Isle.
Mine 3 lunar ores from the stalagmites in the area.
Leave the mine.
Use the Lunar Altar to make some lunar glass.
Smelt the lunar ore into bars at any furnace.
Make the V sigil on any anvil.
Talk to the Fossegrimen south west of Rellekka to enchant the sigil.
Inspect the geyser north of the Mountain Camp.
choices: It's for the good of the Province!

steps.text: Talk to Peer the Seer south west of the Rellekka market.
Inspect the geyser again.
Retrieve your rock from the geyser.
Use the shield parts together to make V's Shield.
Talk to Brundt south east of Rellekka with V's shield.
Talk to Brundt with 2 kegs of beer.
Return to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall.

You can get a fremennik shield from dagannoths in Waterbirth Dungeon or Bardur in Waterbirth Dungeon for 150k, or for free with the Ring of Charos(a). You'll need a friend to get there, or a rune thrownaxe and a pet rock.
Kill basilisks until you're told to stop.
Take the boat to the Isle of Stone.
Talk to Brundt outside the cave entrance.

Attempt to open the door and solve the puzzle. It's Mastermind, where a red tick means you have one of the correct runes in the wrong position, and a green tick means a correct rune in the correct position.
Enter the door, ready to fight.
Fight Typhor, who attacks with both Melee and Magic. He is weak to crush.
Defeat the Jormungand. When the screen turns red, have your character face away from him. When frozen in rock, click repeatedly to break out.
Watch the cutscenes.
Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall to finish the quest.
